answer: Company Action Level RBC has the meaning ascribed under the Domiciliary State’s insurance laws and regulations, or NAIC RBC instructions if not defined there; material changes to state law that cause divergence from Agency Criteria may prompt review and revision of the Specified Minimum Percentage
